shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "mempal search \"downshift useMultipleSelection activeIndex Backspace Delete reducer focused selected item\" --json --top-k 5 && printf '\\n--- AGENTS ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- source matches ---\\n' && rg -n \"useMultipleSelection|activeIndex|Backspace|Delete\" src test -g '*.js' | head -240"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/hooks/useMultipleSelection/reducer.js && printf '\\n--- hook handlers ---\\n' && sed -n '100,225p' src/hooks/useMultipleSelection/index.js"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,150p' src/hooks/useMultipleSelection/__tests__/props.test.js && sed -n '285,410p' src/hooks/useMultipleSelection/__tests__/getSelectedItemProps.test.js && printf '\\n--- reducer tests ---\\n' && rg -n \"reducer|SelectedItemKeyDown\" src/hooks/useMultipleSelection/__tests__ src/hooks/useMultipleSelection -g '*.test.js' -g '*.js'"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- git log ---\\n' && git log -6 --oneline -- src/hooks/useMultipleSelection/reducer.js"

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/hooks/useMultipleSelection/reducer.js src/hooks/useMultipleSelection/__tests__/utils.test.js src/hooks/useMultipleSelection/__tests__/props.test.js'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/downshift-active-index-reducer.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Guard index-dependent reducer actions

Reducer actions that remove or update an indexed collection entry should validate the index before slicing or deriving neighboring state. A sentinel such as "'`-1` and an index beyond the current collection both represent no active entry, so the action should preserve the existing state rather than relying on slice behavior.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
